vulnId.description: The vulnerability ID from the input (e.g., CVE-2024-1234)

SL.description: How technically skilled is this group of threat agents?

M.description: How motivated is this group of threat agents to find and exploit this vulnerability?

O.description: What resources and opportunities are required for this group of threat agents to find and exploit this vulnerability?

S.description: How large is this group of threat agents?

ED.description: How easy is it for this group of threat agents to discover this vulnerability?

EE.description: How easy is it for this group of threat agents to actually exploit this vulnerability?

A.description: How well known is this vulnerability to this group of threat agents?

ID.description: How likely is an exploit to be detected?

LC.description: How much data could be disclosed and how sensitive is it?

LI.description: How much data could be corrupted and how damaged is it?

LAV.description: How much service could be lost and how vital is it?

LAC.description: Are the threat agents' actions traceable to an individual?

FD.description: How much financial damage will result from an exploit?

RD.description: Would an exploit result in reputation damage that would harm the business?

NC.description: How much exposure does non-compliance introduce?

PV.description: How much personally identifiable information could be disclosed?

reasoning.description: Brief explanation of each score (2-3 sentences)
